title: Evidence calculus (E1-E6) and frozen evidence set

predictions.claim: (enc_sol, dec_go) and (enc_go_v1, dec_go) have E1 on all v0/v1 fields, operationalized per version and field by getter recovery over the layout algebra (rule E1 of the tests_m2/test_evidence.py contract): the evidence set holds one E1 inverse atom (CODEC.enc_sol, CODEC.dec_go) at each of versions 0, 1 and 2, recovering every active getter except sequencerSetVerifyHash (v0: the 10 other v0 fields; v1 and v2: those plus lastBlockNumber), because enc_sol stores 32 zero bytes at 185; one at version 1 for (CODEC.enc_go_v1, CODEC.dec_go) recovering every v1 field except version, and one at version 0 for (CODEC.enc_go_v0, CODEC.dec_go) recovering every v0 field except version, because the Go encoders write a constant version byte. So 'all v0/v1 fields' holds except exactly those two fields, each already a known obstruction (L_par_hdr_ssvh; the constant Go version byte of whitepaper 5.1).

Exactly 7 E1 atoms, all in morph_header: the 5 inverse atoms of I14-P1 and two common-decoder atoms, (CODEC.enc_go_v0, CODEC.enc_sol) at version 0 on the 9 fields both recover and (CODEC.enc_go_v1, CODEC.enc_sol) at version 1 on 10 (batchIndex .. withdrawRootHash, parentBatchHash, lastBlockNumber); no E1 atom relates enc_sol and enc_go_v1 at version 2, since enc_go_v1's version label (I11: the constant it writes at the version slot) is 1.

(commit*, revertBatch) have E2 on the BVH residue: for each of commitBatch, commitState and commitBatchWithProof there is an E2 atom p = TRANS.revertBatch, q = TRANS.<commit>, via {carrier: s_bvh, writes: ["*"], reads: ["parent+1"]} (revertBatch writes the residue with s_bvh := concat(es_bvh(moved), s_bvh), a precise whole write through a generic builtin; each commit reads it through bvh_at at parent + 1); none of the three pairs is unresolved, and no E2 atom runs from a commit to revertBatch through s_bvh (revertBatch does not read it).

The previous-state-root guard gives E3: one E3 atom at each reason-14 guard: commitBatch guards[19], commitState guards[18] and commitBatchWithProof guards[23], all at Rollup.sol:314, comparing get(w(lfi, win, parent), csr) with prev; and finalizeBatch guards[9] at Rollup.sol:635-638, comparing nth(fsr, idx - 1) with get(w(lfi, win, idx), prev).

Exactly 9 E3 atoms, all in morph_rollup: the 4 of I14-P4, parent == lci at Rollup.sol:312 in the three commits (guards[18], [17], [22]), lfi + 1 == idx at Rollup.sol:643 (finalizeBatch guards[11]) and qpend == btot - bn at L1MessageQueueWithGasPriceOracle.sol:325 (finalizeBatch guards[14]); comparisons with a literal or a parameter (rri == 0, who == OWNER, proof == 1, ...) give none, and morph_header and morph_batchdata give none.

Exactly 2 E4 atoms: (TRANS.commitBatch -> TRANS.commitBatchWithProof) and (TRANS.commitBatchWithProof -> TRANS.commitBatch), both for blob_hash(ver, blobs), stored by each in effects.win and recomputed by the other; no other stored call takes only action inputs.

Against I13's frozen assignment (t: Time, W: Dur, <commit>.cstart: Time): in each of the three commits, an E5 atom at the reason-16 guard (commitBatch guards[23], commitState guards[22], commitBatchWithProof guards[27]; op <=, operands t and W + cstart, sort Time, Rollup.sol:363) and one at the let prt (guards[24], [23], [28]; op -, operands W + cstart and t, sort Time, Rollup.sol:360-364); no E5 atom is located at LOAD.obs.tags_ok.

Exactly 3 E6 atoms in morph_header, between the three encoders (parallel Header -> Bytes CODEC edges whose cited code names share tokens under spec/M2/lib/evidence_lexical.json): (enc_go_v0, enc_go_v1) on batch, bytes, header; (enc_go_v0, enc_sol) and (enc_go_v1, enc_sol) on batch, header.

GEVID's verdict on the E5 claims, against I13's frozen assignment: L_sort_remaining's E5 is computed (no mismatch on E5): its statement names reason 16, hence the three commits, whose :363 guard and :360-364 let compare or subtract t and W + cstart, both Time. L_tag_BVH's E5 is not computed and GEVID lists it as missing: its statement names only the observer tags_ok, whose body tags_exact(win) holds no comparison, and the registers it is about (Entry.bvh, s_bvh) carry the union Dig[Agg] + Dig[VH], which is no identical refined sort (section 7.4).

GEVID on M0 is report-only and passes, and exactly two laws carry metadata evidence the frozen set does not compute: L_dom_hdr missing [E2] (its predicates name only dec_go, and no atom relates dec_go to itself) and L_par_hdr_v2 missing [E1] (the encoders' common-decoder E1 is at version 1; the law fixes version 2). Computed levels: L_dom_hdr []; L_par_hdr_ssvh, L_par_hdr_v0, L_par_hdr_v1 [E1, E6]; L_par_hdr_v2 [E6]; L_rt_go_v0, v1, v2 [E1, E2].

GEVID on M1 is report-only and passes, and exactly two laws carry metadata evidence the frozen set does not compute: L_nat_eta2 missing [E2] (every write-then-read through eta2, legacy or csr_last passes win through a builtin that declares no access kind, so it is unresolved, not evidence) and L_tag_BVH missing [E2, E5] (E2 likewise through tags_exact; E5 as in I14-P9); L_fact_Z's E4 is computed; every other M1 law's metadata evidence is computed. No E2 atom ends at tags_ok, csr_last or new_hdr, and (commitBatch, tags_ok, win) is unresolved with imprecise [read].

L_par_hdr_ssvh's evidence_triage is finding (its strongest computed level is E1, at version 1), against its v1 triage intent_question, and GEVID lists it as a divergence; its record carries evidence_triage finding next to the unchanged v1 triage.

The divergence list (laws whose evidence_triage differs from their v1 triage) is exactly L_par_hdr_ssvh (finding vs intent_question) and L_par_hdr_v2 (intent_question vs finding: at version 2 only E6 relates enc_sol and enc_go_v1); M1 has none (every REFUTED M1 law has strong evidence or none, and evidence_triage defaults to finding).

Construction check, not counted toward prediction accuracy: `python -m holon evidence --milestone M2` writes gen/M2/evidence.json in the contract's format (header, hashed inputs drawn only from the frozen set, the lexical sidecar as the only vocabulary, schema-valid, sorted unique ids derived from the via, endpoints that are edges and never STORE/LOAD aggregates, anchors that follow the diagrams), evidence_sha256 is the hash of its body and sorts_sha256 the frozen assignment's, two runs are byte-identical and equal the committed file, the build API renders the same bytes, and holon/diagram/evidence.py holds no target name derived from the fact documents and libraries, neither as a compound identifier anywhere nor, short names included, as a string literal; anchors.sites follows the frozen assignment's sites.

predictions.claim: Construction check, not counted: every M0/M1 record carries evidence_levels, evidence_triage and evidence_override equal to the recomputation from the committed evidence set (no override committed), and the v2 schema requires the three fields and rejects malformed values. Whenever laws/M2/REGISTRY.json exists (I15), its evidence_sha256 equals gen/M2/evidence.json's, GEVID passes on M2, and every SORT-site law there carries no evidence key and names exactly its site's actions.

Construction check, not counted (honesty): the evidence set is computed from the diagram and the frozen assignment only. On a copy mutated with I13's honesty mutations (tests_m2/test_sorts_honesty.py), the diagram and sorts regenerated each time: stripping every site annotation, note and sort-stating doc leaves the atoms, unresolved entries and anchors byte-equal (ids included); renaming the rollup facts' hand-chosen identifiers renames them and changes nothing else (ids and site hashes aside).

regressions.claim: The 24 M0/M1 statuses and statement hashes are unchanged.
The v1 triage of every M0/M1 record is unchanged (frozen tests pin it to the predictions; evidence-derived values go only to v2 fields, BUILD_PLAN invariant 10).
gen/M2/diagram and gen/M2/sorts are unchanged and regenerate byte for byte (the evidence set reads them; it never writes them).
Gates M0 and M1 pass, with GEVID (report-only) among their checks.
